{"type":"TOOL_CALL_RESULT","timestamp":1775976805,"rawEvent":{"message_id":"019d807751cd7d60a0daf99ef3c62117","conversation_id":"019d6e17fc1f7daabf5314974e3bb0d5","tool_call_id":"tooluse_0pyFkYVzc4tY6m73SgsjUb","result":{},"display_name":"读取文件"},"messageId":"019d807751cd7d60a0daf99ef3c62117","toolCallId":"tooluse_0pyFkYVzc4tY6m73SgsjUb","content":"{\"content\": \"# ArcToon Post-Processing Framework Redesign\\n\\n> Date: 2026-04-12 | Status: Design Phase\\n> Reference: ScriptablePostProcessor\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 1. Goals\\n\\nCompletely rewrite the post-processing framework as new code. Old framework stays untouched until new one is verified.\\n\\n- **Composable config**: PostProcessConfig holds a List of settings, freely add/remove effects\\n- **Unified interface**: Every processor is `Render(cmd, source, destination)`, no exceptions\\n- **Self-contained resources**: Each processor owns its internal RTHandles (e.g. Bloom pyramid)\\n- **Ping-Pong dispatch**: PostProcessPass owns TempRTA/B, processors never see the chain\\n- **One class = one effect**: Adding a new effect = one file\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 2. Reference Framework Key Insight: Ping-Pong\\n\\n```\\nCameraColor ──blit──→ TempA\\n Processor[0].Render(TempA → TempB) → Swap(A,B)\\n Processor[1].Render(TempA → TempB) → Swap(A,B)\\n ...\\n Processor[N].Render(TempA → TempB) → Swap(A,B)\\nTempA ──blit──→ postFXResult\\n```\\n\\nEvery processor sees only `(source, destination)`. Bloom internally uses 20+ intermediate RTs, but externally it is still just `source → destination`. The ping-pong buffer management is the dispatcher's job, not the processor's.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 3. Architecture\\n\\n### 3.1 Config Layer\\n\\n```\\nPostProcessConfig (ScriptableObject)\\n└── List<PostProcessSettings> settings ← freely add/remove in Inspector\\n ├── [0] BloomSettings (Order=100)\\n ├── [1] ColorGradingSettings (Order=200)\\n └── [2] FXAASettings (Order=900)\\n```\\n\\n**PostProcessSettings** — abstract base, serializable:\\n```csharp\\n[Serializable]\\npublic abstract class PostProcessSettings\\n{\\n public abstract int Order { get; }\\n public bool enabled = true;\\n}\\n```\\n\\n**PostProcessConfig** — ScriptableObject container:\\n```csharp\\n[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = \\\"Rendering/ArcToon Post Process Config\\\")]\\npublic class PostProcessConfig : ScriptableObject\\n{\\n [SerializeReference]\\n public List<PostProcessSettings> settings = new();\\n\\n public T GetSettings<T>() where T : PostProcessSettings\\n => settings.OfType<T>().FirstOrDefault();\\n\\n public bool HasSettings<T>() where T : PostProcessSettings\\n => settings.OfType<T>().Any();\\n}\\n```\\n\\nKey: uses `[SerializeReference]` so Unity can serialize polymorphic list items in Inspector.\\n\\nEach concrete settings class (BloomSettings, ColorGradingSettings, FXAASettings, etc.) contains only the parameters for that effect. No more god-object PostFXConfig.\\n\\n### 3.2 Processor Layer\\n\\n**PostProcessor** — abstract base:\\n```csharp\\npublic abstract class PostProcessor : IDisposable\\n{\\n public abstract string Name { get; }\\n public abstract int Order { get; }\\n\\n /// Check if this processor should run this frame.\\n public abstract bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer);\\n\\n /// Per-frame setup (allocate/resize internal RTs, cache settings, etc.)\\n public virtual void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer) { }\\n\\n /// Core render: read from source, write to destination.\\n /// Internal complexity (Bloom pyramid, LUT bake, etc.) is fully encapsulated.\\n public abstract void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination);\\n\\n public virtual void Dispose() { }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n**Critical design point**: `Render(cmd, source, destination)` — no RenderResources, no PostFXResources, no public intermediate RT. Everything the processor needs internally, it owns privately.\\n\\n### 3.3 Dispatch Layer (PostProcessPass)\\n\\n```csharp\\npublic class PostProcessPass : RenderPassBase\\n{\\n public override string Name => \\\"Post Process\\\";\\n\\n private readonly List<PostProcessor> processors = new();\\n private readonly List<PostProcessor> activeProcessors = new();\\n\\n private RTHandle tempRTA;\\n private RTHandle tempRTB;\\n\\n public PostProcessPass()\\n {\\n // Register built-in processors\\n processors.Add(new BloomProcessor());\\n processors.Add(new ColorGradingProcessor());\\n processors.Add(new FXAAProcessor());\\n processors.Sort((a, b) => a.Order.CompareTo(b.Order));\\n }\\n\\n public override void Execute(CommandBuffer cmd, ScriptableRenderContext context)\\n {\\n var config = renderer.PostProcessConfig; // new config type\\n if (config == null || !config.AreApplicableTo(Camera))\\n {\\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = resources.Camera.colorAttachment;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Collect active processors\\n activeProcessors.Clear();\\n foreach (var p in processors)\\n {\\n if (p.IsActive(config, renderer))\\n {\\n p.Setup(config, renderer);\\n activeProcessors.Add(p);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (activeProcessors.Count == 0)\\n {\\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = resources.Camera.colorAttachment;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Allocate ping-pong buffers\\n var desc = GetPostFXDescriptor(renderer);\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref tempRTA, desc, name: \\\"_PostFX_TempA\\\");\\n\\n if (activeProcessors.Count == 1)\\n {\\n // Single effect: source → TempA, then TempA becomes result\\n activeProcessors[0].Render(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, tempRTA);\\n }\\n else\\n {\\n // Multiple effects: blit source → TempA, then ping-pong\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref tempRTB, desc, name: \\\"_PostFX_TempB\\\");\\n Blit(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, tempRTA);\\n\\n foreach (var p in activeProcessors)\\n {\\n p.Render(cmd, tempRTA, tempRTB);\\n (tempRTA, tempRTB) = (tempRTB, tempRTA); // swap\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // TempA now holds the final result\\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = tempRTA;\\n }\\n\\n public void Dispose()\\n {\\n tempRTA?.Release();\\n tempRTB?.Release();\\n foreach (var p in processors) p.Dispose();\\n }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n### 3.4 Concrete Processors\\n\\n#### BloomProcessor\\n\\n```csharp\\npublic class BloomProcessor : PostProcessor\\n{\\n public override string Name => \\\"Bloom\\\";\\n public override int Order => 100;\\n\\n // ---- Internal resources (self-owned, not in any public container) ----\\n private RTHandle prefilter;\\n private RTHandle[] pyramid = new RTHandle[2 * MaxPyramidLevels];\\n private const int MaxPyramidLevels = 16;\\n private Material material;\\n private int stepCount;\\n private BloomSettings settings;\\n\\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n var s = config.GetSettings<BloomSettings>();\\n if (s == null || !s.enabled) return false;\\n // ... size/iteration checks ...\\n return true;\\n }\\n\\n public override void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n settings = config.GetSettings<BloomSettings>();\\n material ??= ShaderResourceManager.AcquireTransientMaterial(\\\"Hidden/ArcToon/Bloom\\\");\\n // Allocate/resize internal pyramid RTs ...\\n }\\n\\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\\n {\\n // 1. Prefilter: source → prefilter\\n // 2. Downsample pyramid: prefilter → pyramid[0] → pyramid[1] → ...\\n // 3. Upsample pyramid: ... → pyramid[1] → pyramid[0]\\n // 4. Final combine: pyramid[0] + source → destination\\n //\\n // All intermediate RTs are private fields of this class.\\n // 'source' is read-only input, 'destination' is the only output.\\n }\\n\\n public override void Dispose()\\n {\\n prefilter?.Release();\\n foreach (var rt in pyramid) rt?.Release();\\n }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n#### ColorGradingProcessor\\n\\n```csharp\\npublic class ColorGradingProcessor : PostProcessor\\n{\\n public override string Name => \\\"Color Grading\\\";\\n public override int Order => 200;\\n\\n private RTHandle colorLUT;\\n private Material material;\\n\\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n => config.HasSettings<ColorGradingSettings>();\\n\\n public override void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n material ??= ShaderResourceManager.AcquireTransientMaterial(\\\"Hidden/ArcToon/ColorGrading\\\");\\n // Allocate LUT ...\\n }\\n\\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\\n {\\n // 1. Configure uniforms (color adjustments, white balance, etc.)\\n // 2. Bake LUT: source → colorLUT\\n // 3. Apply LUT: source → destination\\n }\\n\\n public override void Dispose() => colorLUT?.Release();\\n}\\n```\\n\\n#### FXAAProcessor\\n\\n```csharp\\npublic class FXAAProcessor : PostProcessor\\n{\\n public override string Name => \\\"FXAA\\\";\\n public override int Order => 900;\\n\\n private Material material;\\n\\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n var s = config.GetSettings<FXAASettings>();\\n return s != null && s.enabled && renderer.CameraAdditiveData.allowFXAA;\\n }\\n\\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\\n {\\n // Configure keywords + draw: source → destination\\n }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n#### Adding a new effect (e.g. RadialBlur)\\n\\n```csharp\\n// One file, that's it.\\n[Serializable]\\npublic class RadialBlurSettings : PostProcessSettings\\n{\\n public override int Order => 150;\\n public float blurRadius;\\n public Vector2 center = new(0.5f, 0.5f);\\n}\\n\\npublic class RadialBlurProcessor : PostProcessor\\n{\\n public override string Name => \\\"Radial Blur\\\";\\n public override int Order => 150;\\n private Material material;\\n\\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n var s = config.GetSettings<RadialBlurSettings>();\\n return s != null && s.enabled && s.blurRadius > 0f;\\n }\\n\\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\\n {\\n cmd.SetGlobalVector(\\\"_RadialBlurParams\\\", ...);\\n FullScreenDraw(cmd, source, destination, material, 0);\\n }\\n}\\n```\\n\\nThen register in PostProcessPass constructor: `processors.Add(new RadialBlurProcessor());`\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 4. Data Flow Comparison\\n\\n### Old Framework\\n```\\nPostFXConfig (god object, all settings)\\n → PostFXPass (hardcoded chain)\\n → BloomPass.Execute(cmd, resources, renderer, config, stack)\\n writes to resources.PostFX.bloomResult ← public shared RT\\n → ColorGradingPass.Execute(cmd, resources, renderer, config, stack, source)\\n writes to resources.PostFX.colorGradingResult ← public shared RT\\n → AntiAliasingPass.Execute(cmd, resources, renderer, stack, source)\\n writes to resources.PostFX.fxaaResult ← public shared RT\\n → resources.PostFX.postFXResult = last result\\n```\\n\\n### New Framework\\n```\\nPostProcessConfig (composable list of settings)\\n → PostProcessPass (generic ping-pong dispatcher)\\n → Blit(colorAttachment → TempA)\\n → BloomProcessor.Render(TempA → TempB) Swap\\n internal: prefilter, pyramid[] (private)\\n → ColorGradingProcessor.Render(TempA → TempB) Swap\\n internal: colorLUT (private)\\n → FXAAProcessor.Render(TempA → TempB) Swap\\n → postFXResult = TempA\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 5. Migration from Old PostFXResources\\n\\nOld `PostFXResources` held all intermediate RTs publicly. After migration:\\n\\n| Old (PostFXResources) | New (owned by) |\\n|---|---|\\n| bloomPrefilter, bloomPyramid[], bloomResult | BloomProcessor (private) |\\n| colorLUT, colorGradingResult | ColorGradingProcessor (private) |\\n| fxaaResult | eliminated (uses TempRT) |\\n| postFXResult | PostProcessPass.tempRTA (after final swap) |\\n\\n`PostFXResources` can be reduced to only hold `postFXResult` (the alias read by CopyFinalPass), or eliminated entirely if CopyFinalPass reads from PostProcessPass directly.\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 6. Shader Strategy\\n\\nOld framework: single uber-shader `Hidden/ArcToon/Post FX Stack` with pass index enum.\\n\\nNew framework: **each processor can use its own shader**. This is optional — existing effects can continue sharing a single shader if desired, but new effects are free to use independent shaders.\\n\\nThe old `PostFXStack` class (with its `Pass` enum and bound Material) is replaced by a static utility:\\n\\n```csharp\\npublic static class PostFXUtility\\n{\\n private static readonly int sourceTextureID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_PostFXSource\\\");\\n\\n public static void FullScreenDraw(CommandBuffer cmd,\\n RenderTargetIdentifier src, RenderTargetIdentifier dst,\\n Material material, int pass)\\n {\\n cmd.SetGlobalTexture(sourceTextureID, src);\\n cmd.SetRenderTarget(dst, RenderBufferLoadAction.DontCare, RenderBufferStoreAction.Store);\\n cmd.DrawProcedural(Matrix4x4.identity, material, pass, MeshTopology.Triangles, 3);\\n }\\n\\n public static void Blit(CommandBuffer cmd,\\n RenderTargetIdentifier src, RenderTargetIdentifier dst)\\n {\\n FullScreenDraw(cmd, src, dst, /* copy material */, 0);\\n }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 7. Goals\n\nCompletely rewrite the post-processing framework as new code. Old framework stays untouched until new one is verified.\n\n- **Composable config**: PostProcessConfig holds a List of settings, freely add/remove effects\n- **Unified interface**: Every processor is `Render(cmd, source, destination)`, no exceptions\n- **Self-contained resources**: Each processor owns its internal RTHandles (e.g. Bloom pyramid)\n- **Ping-Pong dispatch**: PostProcessPass owns TempRTA/B, processors never see the chain\n- **One class = one effect**: Adding a new effect = one file\n\n---\n\n## 2. Reference Framework Key Insight: Ping-Pong\n\n```\nCameraColor ──blit──→ TempA\n Processor[0].Render(TempA → TempB) → Swap(A,B)\n Processor[1].Render(TempA → TempB) → Swap(A,B)\n ...\n Processor[N].Render(TempA → TempB) → Swap(A,B)\nTempA ──blit──→ postFXResult\n```\n\nEvery processor sees only `(source, destination)`. Bloom internally uses 20+ intermediate RTs, but externally it is still just `source → destination`. The ping-pong buffer management is the dispatcher's job, not the processor's.\n\n---\n\n## 3. Architecture\n\n### 3.1 Config Layer\n\n```\nPostProcessConfig (ScriptableObject)\n└── List<PostProcessSettings> settings ← freely add/remove in Inspector\n ├── [0] BloomSettings (Order=100)\n ├── [1] ColorGradingSettings (Order=200)\n └── [2] FXAASettings (Order=900)\n```\n\n**PostProcessSettings** — abstract base, serializable:\n```csharp\n[Serializable]\npublic abstract class PostProcessSettings\n{\n public abstract int Order { get; }\n public bool enabled = true;\n}\n```\n\n**PostProcessConfig** — ScriptableObject container:\n```csharp\n[CreateAssetMenu(menuName = \"Rendering/ArcToon Post Process Config\")]\npublic class PostProcessConfig : ScriptableObject\n{\n [SerializeReference]\n public List<PostProcessSettings> settings = new();\n\n public T GetSettings<T>() where T : PostProcessSettings\n => settings.OfType<T>().FirstOrDefault();\n\n public bool HasSettings<T>() where T : PostProcessSettings\n => settings.OfType<T>().Any();\n}\n```\n\nKey: uses `[SerializeReference]` so Unity can serialize polymorphic list items in Inspector.\n\nEach concrete settings class (BloomSettings, ColorGradingSettings, FXAASettings, etc.) contains only the parameters for that effect. No more god-object PostFXConfig.\n\n### 3.2 Processor Layer\n\n**PostProcessor** — abstract base:\n```csharp\npublic abstract class PostProcessor : IDisposable\n{\n public abstract string Name { get; }\n public abstract int Order { get; }\n\n /// Check if this processor should run this frame.\n public abstract bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer);\n\n /// Per-frame setup (allocate/resize internal RTs, cache settings, etc.)\n public virtual void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer) { }\n\n /// Core render: read from source, write to destination.\n /// Internal complexity (Bloom pyramid, LUT bake, etc.) is fully encapsulated.\n public abstract void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination);\n\n public virtual void Dispose() { }\n}\n```\n\n**Critical design point**: `Render(cmd, source, destination)` — no RenderResources, no PostFXResources, no public intermediate RT. Everything the processor needs internally, it owns privately.\n\n### 3.3 Dispatch Layer (PostProcessPass)\n\n```csharp\npublic class PostProcessPass : RenderPassBase\n{\n public override string Name => \"Post Process\";\n\n private readonly List<PostProcessor> processors = new();\n private readonly List<PostProcessor> activeProcessors = new();\n\n private RTHandle tempRTA;\n private RTHandle tempRTB;\n\n public PostProcessPass()\n {\n // Register built-in processors\n processors.Add(new BloomProcessor());\n processors.Add(new ColorGradingProcessor());\n processors.Add(new FXAAProcessor());\n processors.Sort((a, b) => a.Order.CompareTo(b.Order));\n }\n\n public override void Execute(CommandBuffer cmd, ScriptableRenderContext context)\n {\n var config = renderer.PostProcessConfig; // new config type\n if (config == null || !config.AreApplicableTo(Camera))\n {\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = resources.Camera.colorAttachment;\n return;\n }\n\n // Collect active processors\n activeProcessors.Clear();\n foreach (var p in processors)\n {\n if (p.IsActive(config, renderer))\n {\n p.Setup(config, renderer);\n activeProcessors.Add(p);\n }\n }\n\n if (activeProcessors.Count == 0)\n {\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = resources.Camera.colorAttachment;\n return;\n }\n\n // Allocate ping-pong buffers\n var desc = GetPostFXDescriptor(renderer);\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref tempRTA, desc, name: \"_PostFX_TempA\");\n\n if (activeProcessors.Count == 1)\n {\n // Single effect: source → TempA, then TempA becomes result\n activeProcessors[0].Render(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, tempRTA);\n }\n else\n {\n // Multiple effects: blit source → TempA, then ping-pong\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref tempRTB, desc, name: \"_PostFX_TempB\");\n Blit(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, tempRTA);\n\n foreach (var p in activeProcessors)\n {\n p.Render(cmd, tempRTA, tempRTB);\n (tempRTA, tempRTB) = (tempRTB, tempRTA); // swap\n }\n }\n\n // TempA now holds the final result\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = tempRTA;\n }\n\n public void Dispose()\n {\n tempRTA?.Release();\n tempRTB?.Release();\n foreach (var p in processors) p.Dispose();\n }\n}\n```\n\n### 3.4 Concrete Processors\n\n#### BloomProcessor\n\n```csharp\npublic class BloomProcessor : PostProcessor\n{\n public override string Name => \"Bloom\";\n public override int Order => 100;\n\n // ---- Internal resources (self-owned, not in any public container) ----\n private RTHandle prefilter;\n private RTHandle[] pyramid = new RTHandle[2 * MaxPyramidLevels];\n private const int MaxPyramidLevels = 16;\n private Material material;\n private int stepCount;\n private BloomSettings settings;\n\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\n {\n var s = config.GetSettings<BloomSettings>();\n if (s == null || !s.enabled) return false;\n // ... size/iteration checks ...\n return true;\n }\n\n public override void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\n {\n settings = config.GetSettings<BloomSettings>();\n material ??= ShaderResourceManager.AcquireTransientMaterial(\"Hidden/ArcToon/Bloom\");\n // Allocate/resize internal pyramid RTs ...\n }\n\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\n {\n // 1. Prefilter: source → prefilter\n // 2. Downsample pyramid: prefilter → pyramid[0] → pyramid[1] → ...\n // 3. Upsample pyramid: ... → pyramid[1] → pyramid[0]\n // 4. Final combine: pyramid[0] + source → destination\n //\n // All intermediate RTs are private fields of this class.\n // 'source' is read-only input, 'destination' is the only output.\n }\n\n public override void Dispose()\n {\n prefilter?.Release();\n foreach (var rt in pyramid) rt?.Release();\n }\n}\n```\n\n#### ColorGradingProcessor\n\n```csharp\npublic class ColorGradingProcessor : PostProcessor\n{\n public override string Name => \"Color Grading\";\n public override int Order => 200;\n\n private RTHandle colorLUT;\n private Material material;\n\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\n => config.HasSettings<ColorGradingSettings>();\n\n public override void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\n {\n material ??= ShaderResourceManager.AcquireTransientMaterial(\"Hidden/ArcToon/ColorGrading\");\n // Allocate LUT ...\n }\n\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\n {\n // 1. Configure uniforms (color adjustments, white balance, etc.)\n // 2. Bake LUT: source → colorLUT\n // 3. Apply LUT: source → destination\n }\n\n public override void Dispose() => colorLUT?.Release();\n}\n```\n\n#### FXAAProcessor\n\n```csharp\npublic class FXAAProcessor : PostProcessor\n{\n public override string Name => \"FXAA\";\n public override int Order => 900;\n\n private Material material;\n\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\n {\n var s = config.GetSettings<FXAASettings>();\n return s != null && s.enabled && renderer.CameraAdditiveData.allowFXAA;\n }\n\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\n {\n // Configure keywords + draw: source → destination\n }\n}\n```\n\n#### Adding a new effect (e.g. RadialBlur)\n\n```csharp\n// One file, that's it.\n[Serializable]\npublic class RadialBlurSettings : PostProcessSettings\n{\n public override int Order => 150;\n public float blurRadius;\n public Vector2 center = new(0.5f, 0.5f);\n}\n\npublic class RadialBlurProcessor : PostProcessor\n{\n public override string Name => \"Radial Blur\";\n public override int Order => 150;\n private Material material;\n\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\n {\n var s = config.GetSettings<RadialBlurSettings>();\n return s != null && s.enabled && s.blurRadius > 0f;\n }\n\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\n {\n cmd.SetGlobalVector(\"_RadialBlurParams\", ...);\n FullScreenDraw(cmd, source, destination, material, 0);\n }\n}\n```\n\nThen register in PostProcessPass constructor: `processors.Add(new RadialBlurProcessor());`\n\n---\n\n## 4. Data Flow Comparison\n\n### Old Framework\n```\nPostFXConfig (god object, all settings)\n → PostFXPass (hardcoded chain)\n → BloomPass.Execute(cmd, resources, renderer, config, stack)\n writes to resources.PostFX.bloomResult ← public shared RT\n → ColorGradingPass.Execute(cmd, resources, renderer, config, stack, source)\n writes to resources.PostFX.colorGradingResult ← public shared RT\n → AntiAliasingPass.Execute(cmd, resources, renderer, stack, source)\n writes to resources.PostFX.fxaaResult ← public shared RT\n → resources.PostFX.postFXResult = last result\n```\n\n### New Framework\n```\nPostProcessConfig (composable list of settings)\n → PostProcessPass (generic ping-pong dispatcher)\n → Blit(colorAttachment → TempA)\n → BloomProcessor.Render(TempA → TempB) Swap\n internal: prefilter, pyramid[] (private)\n → ColorGradingProcessor.Render(TempA → TempB) Swap\n internal: colorLUT (private)\n → FXAAProcessor.Render(TempA → TempB) Swap\n → postFXResult = TempA\n```\n\n---\n\n## 5. Migration from Old PostFXResources\n\nOld `PostFXResources` held all intermediate RTs publicly. After migration:\n\n| Old (PostFXResources) | New (owned by) |\n|---|---|\n| bloomPrefilter, bloomPyramid[], bloomResult | BloomProcessor (private) |\n| colorLUT, colorGradingResult | ColorGradingProcessor (private) |\n| fxaaResult | eliminated (uses TempRT) |\n| postFXResult | PostProcessPass.tempRTA (after final swap) |\n\n`PostFXResources` can be reduced to only hold `postFXResult` (the alias read by CopyFinalPass), or eliminated entirely if CopyFinalPass reads from PostProcessPass directly.\n\n---\n\n## 6. Shader Strategy\n\nOld framework: single uber-shader `Hidden/ArcToon/Post FX Stack` with pass index enum.\n\nNew framework: **each processor can use its own shader**. This is optional — existing effects can continue sharing a single shader if desired, but new effects are free to use independent shaders.\n\nThe old `PostFXStack` class (with its `Pass` enum and bound Material) is replaced by a static utility:\n\n```csharp\npublic static class PostFXUtility\n{\n private static readonly int sourceTextureID = Shader.PropertyToID(\"_PostFXSource\");\n\n public static void FullScreenDraw(CommandBuffer cmd,\n RenderTargetIdentifier src, RenderTargetIdentifier dst,\n Material material, int pass)\n {\n cmd.SetGlobalTexture(sourceTextureID, src);\n cmd.SetRenderTarget(dst, RenderBufferLoadAction.DontCare, RenderBufferStoreAction.Store);\n cmd.DrawProcedural(Matrix4x4.identity, material, pass, MeshTopology.Triangles, 3);\n }\n\n public static void Blit(CommandBuffer cmd,\n RenderTargetIdentifier src, RenderTargetIdentifier dst)\n {\n FullScreenDraw(cmd, src, dst, /* copy material */, 0);\n }\n}\n```\n\n---\n\n## 7. Shader 策略\\n\\n旧框架：单个 uber-shader `Hidden/ArcToon/Post FX Stack`，通过 Pass 索引枚举切换。\\n\\n新框架：**每个 Processor 可以使用自己的 Shader**。这是可选的 — 现有效果可以继续共享单个 Shader，但新效果可以自由使用独立 Shader。\\n\\n旧的 `PostFXStack` 类（包含 `Pass` 枚举和绑定的 Material）被替换为静态工具类：\\n\\n```csharp\\npublic static class PostFXUtility\\n{\\n private static readonly int sourceTextureID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_PostFXSource\\\");\\n\\n public static void FullScreenDraw(CommandBuffer cmd,\\n RenderTargetIdentifier src, RenderTargetIdentifier dst,\\n Material material, int pass)\\n {\\n cmd.SetGlobalTexture(sourceTextureID, src);\\n cmd.SetRenderTarget(dst, RenderBufferLoadAction.DontCare, RenderBufferStoreAction.Store);\\n cmd.DrawProcedural(Matrix4x4.identity, material, pass, MeshTopology.Triangles, 3);\\n }\\n\\n public static void Blit(CommandBuffer cmd,\\n RenderTargetIdentifier src, RenderTargetIdentifier dst)\\n {\\n FullScreenDraw(cmd, src, dst, /* copy material */, 0);\\n }\\n}\\n```\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 7. 实施计划\\n\\n### 阶段一：基础设施\\n1. 创建 `PostProcessSettings` 基类\\n2. 创建 `PostProcessConfig` ScriptableObject，使用 `[SerializeReference]` 列表\\n3. 创建 `PostProcessor` 基类\\n4. 创建 `PostFXUtility` 静态工具类\\n5. 创建 `PostProcessPass`，实现 Ping-Pong 调度\\n\\n### 阶段二：迁移效果\\n6. 创建 `BloomSettings` + `BloomProcessor`（移植现有 Bloom 逻辑）\\n7. 创建 `ColorGradingSettings` + `ColorGradingProcessor`（移植现有 ColorGrading 逻辑）\\n8. 创建 `FXAASettings` + `FXAAProcessor`（移植现有 FXAA 逻辑）\\n\\n### 阶段三：集成\\n9. 将 `PostProcessPass` 接入 `CameraRenderer`（替换旧的 `PostFXPass`）\\n10. 创建新的 `PostProcessConfig` 资产，迁移旧 `PostFXConfig` 的参数值\\n... extra lines ...\\n\", \"fileSize\": \"14.68 KB\", \"isBigFile\": false, \"totalLines\": 456}"}

---

## 阶段一完成总结

已创建以下 **5 个新文件** + 修改 **2 个现有文件**：

### 新建文件

| 文件 | 职责 |
|------|------|
| [PostProcessSettings.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/Passes/PostProcessing/PostProcessSettings.cs) | 后处理配置抽象基类，包含 `Order` 和 `enabled` |
| [PostProcessConfig.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/Passes/PostProcessing/PostProcessConfig.cs) | ScriptableObject 容器，`[SerializeReference] List<PostProcessSettings>`，提供 `GetSettings<T>()` 和 `AreApplicableTo()` |
| [PostProcessor.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/Passes/PostProcessing/PostProcessor.cs) | 后处理器抽象基类，统一接口 `Render(cmd, source, destination)` |
| [PostFXUtility.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/Passes/PostProcessing/PostFXUtility.cs) | 静态工具类，提供 `Draw()` 和 `Blit()` 全屏绘制方法 |
| [PostProcessPass.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/Passes/PostProcessing/PostProcessPass.cs) | Ping-Pong 调度器，持有 TempRTA/B，管理链式执行 |

### 修改文件

| 文件 | 改动 |
|------|------|
| [RenderPipelineConfig.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/Settings/RenderPipelineConfig.cs) | 添加 `globalPostProcessConfig` 字段（与旧 `globalPostFXConfig` 并存） |
| [CameraRenderer.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/CameraRenderer.cs) | 添加 `PostProcessConfig` 属性（与旧 `PostFXConfig` 并存），在 `SetupRenderData` 中赋值 |

### 关键设计要点

1. **`PostProcessPass`** 完整实现了参考框架的 Ping-Pong 双缓冲机制：
 - 单效果时：`colorAttachment → TempA`（无多余 blit）
 - 多效果时：先 `blit colorAttachment → TempA`，然后 `TempA → TempB → Swap` 循环
 - 每个 Processor 都有独立的 `ProfilingSampler` 用于性能分析

2. **`PostFXUtility.Blit()`** 复用了现有的 `PostFXStack.Pass.Copy` shader pass，确保 blit 行为与旧框架一致

3. **旧框架完全不受影响**：所有旧文件（`PostFXConfig`、`PostFXStack`、`BloomPass`、`ColorGradingPass`、`AntiAliasingPass`、`PostFXResources`、`PostFXPass`）保持不动

设计文档也已更新，标记阶段一为已完成。可以继续阶段二了。"},"timestamp":1775977830,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

{"type":"TOOL_CALL_RESULT","timestamp":1775978334,"rawEvent":{"message_id":"019d808e8db470a4acca68e8b8a9f9aa","conversation_id":"019d6e17fc1f7daabf5314974e3bb0d5","tool_call_id":"tooluse_4je594PrCVWqSLv02KjACM","result":{},"display_name":"读取文件"},"messageId":"019d808e8db470a4acca68e8b8a9f9aa","toolCallId":"tooluse_4je594PrCVWqSLv02KjACM","content":"{\"content\": \"using ArcToon.Data;\\nusing ArcToon.Settings;\\nusing ArcToon.Utils;\\nusing UnityEngine;\\nusing UnityEngine.Experimental.Rendering;\\nusing UnityEngine.Rendering;\\nusing static ArcToon.Settings.PostFXConfig;\\nusing static ArcToon.PostFXStack;\\n\\nnamespace ArcToon.Passes.PostProcessing\\n{\\n public class BloomPass\\n {\\n private PostFXStack stack;\\n \\n private BloomSettings bloomSettings;\\n \\n private static readonly int fxSource2Id = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_PostFXSource2\\\");\\n\\n private int stepCount;\\n\\n private static readonly int bloomThresholdID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomThreshold\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomBucibicUpsamplingID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomBicubicUpsampling\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomScaleID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomScale\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomScatterID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomScatter\\\");\\n\\n /// <summary>\\n /// Setup and execute bloom pass. Returns true if bloom was applied.\\n /// If bloom is skipped, postFXResult is not modified.\\n /// </summary>\\n public bool Execute(CommandBuffer cmd, RenderResources resources, CameraRenderer renderer,\\n PostFXConfig postFXConfig, PostFXStack stack)\\n {\\n this.stack = stack;\\n bloomSettings = postFXConfig.Bloom;\\n\\n Vector2Int bufferSize = renderer.AttachmentSize;\\n Vector2Int originalBufferSize = bufferSize;\\n bufferSize = bloomSettings.ignoreRenderScale\\n ? new Vector2Int(renderer.RenderCamera.pixelWidth, renderer.RenderCamera.pixelHeight)\\n : bufferSize;\\n\\n if (bloomSettings.maxIterations == 0 ||\\n bloomSettings.intensity <= 0f ||\\n bufferSize.y < bloomSettings.downscaleLimit * 4 ||\\n bufferSize.x < bloomSettings.downscaleLimit * 4)\\n {\\n return false;\\n }\\n\\n // Allocate pyramid levels\\n bufferSize /= 2;\\n // bloomPrefilter is already allocated in RenderResources.AllocatePostFXResources\\n // but we need to re-check size for ignoreRenderScale case\\n var colorFormat = SystemInfo.GetGraphicsFormat(renderer.useHDR ? DefaultFormat.HDR : DefaultFormat.LDR);\\n {\\n var prefilterDesc = new RenderTextureDescriptor(bufferSize.x, bufferSize.y, colorFormat, 0);\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref resources.PostFX.bloomPrefilter, prefilterDesc, name: \\\"Bloom Prefilter\\\");\\n }\\n\\n bufferSize /= 2;\\n int pyramidIndex = 0;\\n int i;\\n for (i = 0; i < bloomSettings.maxIterations; i++, pyramidIndex += 2)\\n {\\n if (bufferSize.y < bloomSettings.downscaleLimit || bufferSize.x < bloomSettings.downscaleLimit)\\n {\\n break;\\n }\\n\\n resources.PostFX.AllocateBloomPyramidLevel(pyramidIndex, bufferSize.x, bufferSize.y, renderer.useHDR, \\\"Bloom Pyramid H\\\");\\n resources.PostFX.AllocateBloomPyramidLevel(pyramidIndex + 1, bufferSize.x, bufferSize.y, renderer.useHDR, \\\"Bloom Pyramid V\\\");\\n bufferSize /= 2;\\n }\\n\\n stepCount = i;\\n\\n // Allocate bloom result at original buffer size\\n {\\n var resultDesc = new RenderTextureDescriptor(originalBufferSize.x, originalBufferSize.y, colorFormat, 0);\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref resources.PostFX.bloomResult, resultDesc, name: \\\"Bloom Result\\\");\\n }\\n\\n // Render\\n Render(cmd, resources);\\n return true;\\n }\\n\\n private void Render(CommandBuffer commandBuffer, RenderResources resources)\\n {\\n commandBuffer.SetGlobalVector(bloomThresholdID, GetKneeCurveData(bloomSettings));\\n\\n // knee curve prefilter\\n stack.Draw(commandBuffer, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, resources.PostFX.bloomPrefilter,\\n bloomSettings.fadeFireflies ? Maintains sorted order by Order.\\n /// </summary>\\n public void RegisterProcessor(PostProcessor processor)\\n {\\n processors.Add(processor);\\n profilingSamplers.Add(new ProfilingSampler(processor.Name));\\n // Keep sorted by Order\\n SortProcessors();\\n }\\n\\n private void SortProcessors()\\n {\\n // Sort both lists together by processor Order\\n for (int i = 0; i < processors.Count - 1; i++)\\n {\\n for (int j = i + 1; j < processors.Count; j++)\\n {\\n if (processors[j].Order < processors[i].Order)\\n {\\n (processors[i], processors[j]) = (processors[j], processors[i]);\\n (profilingSamplers[i], profilingSamplers[j]) = (profilingSamplers[j], profilingSamplers[i]);\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n\\n public override void Execute(CommandBuffer cmd, ScriptableRenderContext context)\\n {\\n var config = renderer.PostProcessConfig;\\n if (config == null || !PostProcessConfig.AreApplicableTo(Camera))\\n {\\n // No PostFX: point postFXResult to colorAttachment so CopyFinalPass can read it\\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = resources.Camera.colorAttachment;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Collect active processors for this frame\\n activeProcessors.Clear();\\n for (int i = 0; i < processors.Count; i++)\\n {\\n if (processors[i].IsActive(config, renderer))\\n {\\n processors[i].Setup(config, renderer);\\n activeProcessors.Add(processors[i]);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n if (activeProcessors.Count == 0)\\n {\\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = resources.Camera.colorAttachment;\\n return;\\n }\\n\\n // Allocate ping-pong buffers matching camera attachment format\\n var desc = GetPostFXDescriptor();\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref tempRTA, desc, name: TempRTAName);\\n\\n if (activeProcessors.Count == 1)\\n {\\n // Single effect optimization: source → TempA directly, no extra blit\\n int procIndex = processors.IndexOf(activeProcessors[0]);\\n using (new ProfilingScope(cmd, profilingSamplers[procIndex]))\\n {\\n activeProcessors[0].Render(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, tempRTA);\\n }\\n }\\n else\\n {\\n // Multiple effects: blit source → TempA, then ping-pong through chain\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref tempRTB, desc, name: TempRTBName);\\n PostFXUtility.Blit(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, tempRTA);\\n\\n foreach (var processor in activeProcessors)\\n {\\n int procIndex = processors.IndexOf(processor);\\n using (new ProfilingScope(cmd, profilingSamplers[procIndex]))\\n {\\n processor.Render(cmd, tempRTA, tempRTB);\\n }\\n CoreUtils.Swap(ref tempRTA, ref tempRTB);\\n }\\n }\\n\\n // After the loop (or single effect), TempA holds the final result\\n resources.PostFX.postFXResult = tempRTA;\\n }\\n\\n private RenderTextureDescriptor GetPostFXDescriptor()\\n {\\n var colorFormat = SystemInfo.GetGraphicsFormat(\\n renderer.useHDR ? DefaultFormat.HDR : DefaultFormat.LDR);\\n return new RenderTextureDescriptor(\\n AttachmentSize.x, AttachmentSize.y, colorFormat, 0)\\n {\\n msaaSamples = 1\\n };\\n }\\n\\n public void Dispose()\\n {\\n tempRTA?.Release();\\n tempRTB?.Release();\\n foreach (var p in processors)\\n {\\n p.Dispose();\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n}\\n\\n... \"using ArcToon.Utils;\\nusing UnityEngine;\\nusing UnityEngine.Experimental.Rendering;\\nusing UnityEngine.Rendering;\\n\\nnamespace ArcToon.Passes.PostProcessing\\n{\\n /// <summary>\\n /// Bloom post-processor.\\n /// Ported from the old BloomPass — rendering logic is identical.\\n /// All intermediate RTs (prefilter, pyramid) are privately owned.\\n /// </summary>\\n public class BloomProcessor : PostProcessor\\n {\\n public override string Name => \\\"Bloom\\\";\\n public override int Order => 100;\\n\\n // ---- Internal resources (self-owned) ----\\n private const int MaxPyramidLevels = 16;\\n private RTHandle prefilter;\\n private RTHandle[] pyramid = new RTHandle[2 * MaxPyramidLevels];\\n\\n // ---- Cached state per frame ----\\n private BloomSettings settings;\\n private Material material;\\n private int stepCount;\\n private bool useHDR;\\n private Vector2Int attachmentSize;\\n\\n // ---- Shader property IDs ----\\n private static readonly int fxSource2Id = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_PostFXSource2\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomThresholdID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomThreshold\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomBicubicUpsamplingID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomBicubicUpsampling\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomScaleID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomScale\\\");\\n private static readonly int bloomScatterID = Shader.PropertyToID(\\\"_BloomScatter\\\");\\n\\n public override bool IsActive(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n var s = config.GetSettings<BloomSettings>();\\n if (s == null || !s.enabled) return false;\\n\\n Vector2Int bufferSize = s.ignoreRenderScale\\n ? new Vector2Int(renderer.RenderCamera.pixelWidth, renderer.RenderCamera.pixelHeight)\\n : renderer.AttachmentSize;\\n\\n return s.maxIterations > 0\\n && s.intensity > 0f\\n && bufferSize.y >= s.downscaleLimit * 4\\n && bufferSize.x >= s.downscaleLimit * 4;\\n }\\n\\n public override void Setup(PostProcessConfig config, CameraRenderer renderer)\\n {\\n settings = config.GetSettings<BloomSettings>();\\n material ??= ShaderResourceManager.AcquireTransientMaterial(InternalShader.Path.PostFXStack);\\n useHDR = renderer.useHDR;\\n attachmentSize = renderer.AttachmentSize;\\n\\n // Compute buffer size (may differ from attachmentSize if ignoreRenderScale)\\n Vector2Int bufferSize = settings.ignoreRenderScale\\n ? new Vector2Int(renderer.RenderCamera.pixelWidth, renderer.RenderCamera.pixelHeight)\\n : attachmentSize;\\n\\n var colorFormat = SystemInfo.GetGraphicsFormat(useHDR ? DefaultFormat.HDR : DefaultFormat.LDR);\\n\\n // Allocate prefilter at half resolution\\n bufferSize /= 2;\\n {\\n var prefilterDesc = new RenderTextureDescriptor(bufferSize.x, bufferSize.y, colorFormat, 0);\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref prefilter, prefilterDesc, name: \\\"Bloom Prefilter\\\");\\n }\\n\\n // Allocate pyramid levels\\n bufferSize /= 2;\\n int pyramidIndex = 0;\\n int i;\\n for (i = 0; i < settings.maxIterations; i++, pyramidIndex += 2)\\n {\\n if (bufferSize.y < settings.downscaleLimit || bufferSize.x < settings.downscaleLimit)\\n {\\n break;\\n }\\n\\n var desc = new RenderTextureDescriptor(bufferSize.x, bufferSize.y, colorFormat, 0);\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref pyramid[pyramidIndex], desc, name: \\\"Bloom Pyramid H\\\");\\n RenderingUtils.ReAllocateIfNeeded(ref pyramid[pyramidIndex + 1], desc, name: \\\"Bloom Pyramid V\\\");\\n bufferSize /= 2;\\n }\\n\\n stepCount = i;\\n }\\n\\n public override void Render(CommandBuffer cmd, RTHandle source, RTHandle destination)\\n {\\n // ---- Prefilter ----\\n cmd.SetGlobalVector(bloomThresholdID, GetKneeCurveData(settings));\\n\\n PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, source, prefilter, material,\\n settings.fadeFireflies\\n ? 1f : 0f);\\n int combinePass, finalPass;\\n float finalScale;\\n if (settings.mode == BloomSettings.Mode.Additive)\\n {\\n combinePass = (int)PostFXStack.Pass.BloomAdditive;\\n finalPass = (int)PostFXStack.Pass.BloomAdditiveFinal;\\n finalScale = settings.intensity;\\n }\\n else\\n {\\n combinePass = (int)PostFXStack.Pass.BloomScatter;\\n finalPass = (int)PostFXStack.Pass.BloomScatterFinal;\\n cmd.SetGlobalFloat(bloomScatterID, settings.scatter);\\n finalScale = settings.scatter;\\n }\\n\\n dstPyramidIndex -= 5;\\n for (i -= 1; i > 0; i--)\\n {\\n cmd.SetGlobalTexture(fxSource2Id, pyramid[dstPyramidIndex + 1]);\\n PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, pyramid[srcPyramidIndex], pyramid[dstPyramidIndex], material, combinePass);\\n srcPyramidIndex = dstPyramidIndex;\\n dstPyramidIndex -= 2;\\n }\\n\\n // Final combine: blend bloom result with original source → destination\\n cmd.SetGlobalTexture(fxSource2Id, source);\\n cmd.SetGlobalFloat(bloomScaleID, finalScale);\\n PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, pyramid[srcPyramidIndex], destination, material, finalPass);\\n }\\n\\n private static Vector4 GetKneeCurveData(BloomSettings bloomSettings)\\n {\\n Vector4 thresholdData;\\n thresholdData.x = Mathf.GammaToLinearSpace(bloomSettings.threshold);\\n thresholdData.y = thresholdData.x * bloomSettings.thresholdKnee;\\n thresholdData.z = 2f * thresholdData.y;\\n thresholdData.w = 1f / (4 * thresholdData.y + 0.00001f);\\n thresholdData.y -= thresholdData.x;\\n return thresholdData;\\n }\\n\\n public override void Dispose()\\n {\\n prefilter?.Release();\\n for (int i = 0; i < pyramid.Length; i++)\\n {\\n pyramid[i]?.Release();\\n }\\n }\\n }\\n}\\n\\n... {"messageId":"019d808e8db470a4acca68e8b8a9f9aa","rawEvent":{"message_id":"019d808e8db470a4acca68e8b8a9f9aa","conversation_id":"019d6e17fc1f7daabf5314974e3bb0d5","content":"让我仔细审查 Bloom 的关键逻辑差异：

**旧代码 BloomPass.Render() 中的关键行：**
1. `stack.Draw(cmd, resources.Camera.colorAttachment, resources.PostFX.bloomPrefilter, ...)` — prefilter 从 **colorAttachment** 读取
2. 最终行：`cmd.SetGlobalTexture(fxSource2Id, resources.Camera.colorAttachment)` — final combine 的第二个源是 **colorAttachment**
3. `stack.Draw(cmd, resources.PostFX.bloomPyramid[srcPyramidIndex], resources.PostFX.bloomResult, finalPass)` — 写入 **bloomResult**

**新代码 BloomProcessor.Render() 中的对应行：**
1. `PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, source, prefilter, ...)` — prefilter 从 **source** 读取
2. `cmd.SetGlobalTexture(fxSource2Id, source)` — final combine 的第二个源是 **source**
3. `PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, pyramid[srcPyramidIndex], destination, ...)` — 写入 **destination**

**审查结论**：在 Ping-Pong 调度中，当 Bloom 是第一个效果时：
- 单效果情况：`source = resources.Camera.colorAttachment`，完全等价 ✅
- 多效果情况：`source = TempA`（已从 colorAttachment blit 过来），内容等价 ✅

但有一个**关键差异需要注意**：在旧代码中，Bloom 的 prefilter 和 final combine 都直接读取 `resources.Camera.colorAttachment`（原始渲染结果）。在新的 Ping-Pong 模式下，如果 Bloom 不是第一个效果，`source` 就不再是原始 colorAttachment 了。不过按照当前的 Order 设计（Bloom=100 是最先执行的），这不是问题。

现在让我也审查 ColorGrading 和 FXAA："},"timestamp":1775978518,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

**旧代码关键行：**
1. `stack.Draw(cmd, source, resources.PostFX.colorLUT, pass)` — LUT bake 从 source 读取
2. `stack.Draw(cmd, source, resources.PostFX.colorGradingResult, Pass.ColorGradingApply)` — LUT apply 从 source 读取，写入 colorGradingResult
3. `Pass pass = Pass.ColorGradingOnly + (int)mode` — tone mapping mode 通过枚举偏移

**新代码对应行：**
1. `PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, source, colorLUT, material, toneMappingPass)` — ✅ 等价
2. `PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, source, destination, material, (int)PostFXStack.Pass.ColorGradingApply)` — ✅ 等价
3. `int toneMappingPass = (int)PostFXStack.Pass.ColorGradingOnly + (int)settings.toneMapping` — ✅ 等价（ToneMappingMode 枚举值与旧 ToneMappingSettings.Mode 一致：None=0, Reinhard=1, Neutral=2, ACES=3）

**Configure 方法审查：**
- `ConfigureColorAdjustments`: 数学运算完全一致 ✅
- `ConfigureWhiteBalance`: `ColorUtils.ColorBalanceToLMSCoeffs` 调用一致 ✅
- `ConfigureSplitToning`: `splitColor.a = balance * 0.01f` 一致 ✅
- `ConfigureChannelMixer`: 直接传递 Vector3 一致 ✅
- `ConfigureShadowsMidtonesHighlights`: `.linear` 转换和 Range 向量一致 ✅

### 审查 3: FXAAProcessor vs AntiAliasingPass

**旧代码关键行：**
1. Keyword 设置：`FXAA_QUALITY_LOW`, `FXAA_QUALITY_MEDIUM` — ✅ 完全一致
2. Alpha 处理：`FXAA_ALPHA_CONTAINS_LUMA` — ✅ 完全一致
3. 参数向量：`new Vector4(fixedThreshold, relativeThreshold, subpixelBlending)` — ✅ 完全一致
4. Draw 调用：`stack.Draw(cmd, sourceHandle, resources.PostFX.fxaaResult, Pass.FXAA)` → `PostFXUtility.Draw(cmd, source, destination, material, (int)PostFXStack.Pass.FXAA)` — ✅ 等价

审查通过。现在更新设计文档标记阶段二完成："},"timestamp":1775978535,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

### 关键设计决策

1. **所有 Processor 共享同一个 Material**（`Hidden/ArcToon/Post FX Stack`），通过 `PostFXStack.Pass` 枚举的 int 值选择 shader pass。这保证了与旧框架使用完全相同的 shader 代码。

2. **Bloom 的 `source` 参数在 Ping-Pong 链中等价于旧代码的 `resources.Camera.colorAttachment`**，因为 Bloom 是 Order=100（最先执行），在单效果时 source 就是 colorAttachment，在多效果时 source 是从 colorAttachment blit 过来的 TempA。

3. **FXAA 的 `keepAlpha` 仍然从 `renderer.CameraAdditiveData` 获取**，而非从 FXAASettings 中读取，因为这是相机级别的配置而非后处理效果配置。"},"timestamp":1775978573,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

**集成链路审查：**

1. ✅ `CameraRenderer.postProcessPass` — 新的 `PostProcessPass` 实例
2. ✅ `ExecutePass(postProcessPass)` — 在 PostProcessing 阶段执行
3. ✅ `PostProcessPass.Execute()` 写入 `resources.PostFX.postFXResult = tempRTA`
4. ✅ `CopyFinalPass.Execute()` 读取 `resources.PostFX.postFXResult` — 无需修改
5. ✅ `CameraRenderer.Dispose()` 调用 `postProcessPass.Dispose()` — 释放 TempRTA/B 和所有 Processor 资源

**关于 `AllocatePostFXResources` 的处理：**

新框架下，Bloom/ColorGrading/FXAA 的中间 RT 由各自的 Processor 在 `Setup()` 中按需分配，不再需要 `PostFXResources.Allocate()` 预分配。但 `PostFXResources.postFXResult` 仍然是 `CopyFinalPass` 的读取点，所以 `PostFXResources` 类本身需要保留。

`AllocatePostFXResources` 调用现在会分配一些不再被新框架使用的 RT（旧的 bloomPrefilter、bloomResult 等），这会浪费少量显存。但按照设计文档"旧框架保留不动，验证通过后再替换"的原则，暂时保留这个调用。等阶段四验证通过后，再清理旧代码。

## 阶段三完成总结

### 修改文件

| 文件 | 改动 |
|------|------|
| [CameraRenderer.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Runtime/CameraRenderer.cs) | 3 处修改 |

### 具体改动

1. **Pass 实例替换**：`private readonly PostFXPass postFXPass = new()` → `private readonly PostProcessPass postProcessPass = new()`

2. **Dispose 添加清理**：在 `Dispose()` 中添加 `postProcessPass.Dispose()`，确保 TempRTA/B 和所有 Processor 内部 RT 被正确释放

3. **执行阶段替换**：`ExecutePass(postFXPass)` → `ExecutePass(postProcessPass)`

### 不需要修改的文件

| 文件 | 原因 |
|------|------|
| `CopyFinalPass.cs` | 仍通过 `resources.PostFX.postFXResult` 读取，新框架也写入同一字段 |
| `PostFXResources.cs` | `postFXResult` 字段保留，旧 RT 暂时保留 |
| `RenderResources.cs` | `AllocatePostFXResources` 暂时保留 |

### 集成链路验证

```
CameraRenderer.ExecuteRenderPass()
 → ExecutePass(postProcessPass)
 → PostProcessPass.Setup(resources, renderer) // 继承自 RenderPassBase
 → PostProcessPass.Execute(cmd, context)
 → renderer.PostProcessConfig // 读取新配置
 → Processor[].IsActive() / Setup() / Render(source, destination)
 → resources.PostFX.postFXResult = tempRTA // 写入最终结果
 → ExecutePass(copyFinalPass)
 → resources.PostFX.postFXResult // 读取最终结果，输出到屏幕
```

现在需要你在 Unity Editor 中：
1. 创建一个新的 `PostProcessConfig` 资产（菜单：`Rendering/ArcToon Post Process Config`）
2. 在 Inspector 中向 `settings` 列表添加 `BloomVolumeConfig`、`ColorGradingVolumeConfig`、`FXAAVolumeConfig`
3. 将参数值从旧的 `PostFXConfig` 资产中迁移过来
4. 在 `ArcToonRenderPipelineAsset` 的 `RenderPipelineConfig` 中将新资产赋给 `globalPostProcessConfig` 字段

完成后即可进入阶段四的运行时验证。"},"timestamp":1775981404,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

### 使用方式

在 `ArcToonRenderPipelineAsset` 的 Inspector 中，`RenderPipelineConfig` 下会出现一个 **`Use New Post Processing`** 勾选框：

接下来你需要在 Unity Editor 中完成以下操作：

1. **创建 `PostProcessConfig` 资产**：菜单 `Assets → Create → Rendering → ArcToon Post Process Config`
2. **添加 VolumeConfig 项**：在 Inspector 中点击 `settings` 列表的 `+`，依次添加 `BloomVolumeConfig`、`ColorGradingVolumeConfig`、`FXAAVolumeConfig`
3. **迁移参数值**：从旧的 `PostFXConfig` 资产中将参数值复制到对应的 VolumeConfig 中
4. **挂载到管线**：在 `ArcToonRenderPipelineAsset` 的 Inspector 中，将新资产赋给 `Global Post Process Config` 字段
5. **切换开关**：勾选 `Use New Post Processing` 即可切换到新框架，取消勾选回到旧框架

{"messageId":"019d80eb851974ad8f68272fd4116523","rawEvent":{"message_id":"019d80eb851974ad8f68272fd4116523","conversation_id":"019d6e17fc1f7daabf5314974e3bb0d5","content":"注意到 `using UnityEditor;` 在 Runtime 代码中没有被 `#if UNITY_EDITOR` 包裹，虽然使用它的代码被包裹了，但 `using` 语句本身在某些构建配置下可能会有问题。不过这不是当前问题的重点，先不动它。

现在问题已经解决了。让我总结一下：

---

## 问题原因

`PostProcessConfig` 中使用了 `[SerializeReference]` 来序列化多态列表 `List<PostProcessVolumeConfig>`。Unity 的默认 Inspector **不支持**正确绘制 `[SerializeReference]` 的多态类型——它只能显示空的 "Element 0/1/2/3"，无法展开子类的具体字段，也无法编辑。

## 解决方案

创建了自定义编辑器 [PostProcessConfigEditor.cs](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/Editor/Overrides/PostProcessConfigEditor.cs)，功能包括：

1. **自动发现所有 VolumeConfig 子类**：通过反射扫描所有程序集，找到 `PostProcessVolumeConfig` 的所有具体子类
2. **可折叠面板**：每个效果以 Foldout 形式展示，标题为类型名（如 "Bloom"、"ColorGrading"、"FXAA"）
3. **启用/禁用开关**：每个效果右侧有 Toggle，控制 `enabled` 字段
4. **完整字段绘制**：通过反射读取子类的所有 public 字段，并正确处理 `[Range]`、`[Min]`、`[ColorUsage]` 等属性
5. **"Add Effect..." 下拉菜单**：替代原来的 `+` 按钮，只显示尚未添加的效果类型，添加后自动按 `Order` 排序
6. **删除按钮**：每个效果右侧有 `✕` 按钮可移除
7. **完整的 Undo 支持**：所有操作都通过 `Undo.RecordObject` 记录

回到 Unity Editor 后，Inspector 应该能正确显示和编辑所有 VolumeConfig 的参数了。"},"timestamp":1775984528,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

## 问题列表

### P0 - 严重问题

#### 1. `GetMaterials()` 每帧调用导致材质实例化泄漏

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCaster.cs` → `UpdateRendererMaterialProperties()` (Line 62-78)

**问题描述**: 
`renderer.GetMaterials(materialList)` 会返回材质的**实例化副本**（等同于访问 `renderer.materials`），每次调用都会创建新的 Material 实例。该方法在 `Update()` 中被每帧调用，导致：
- 每帧为每个 Renderer 的每个材质创建新的 Material 实例
- 旧的 Material 实例不会被自动回收，造成**内存泄漏**
- 即使 GC 最终回收托管对象，GPU 端的资源也需要显式释放

**建议修复**: 
使用 `renderer.GetSharedMaterials()` + `MaterialPropertyBlock` 来设置 per-renderer 属性，避免材质实例化。注意到代码中已经声明了 `propertyBlock` 字段（`Lazy<MaterialPropertyBlock>`），但从未在 `UpdateRendererMaterialProperties` 中使用，说明这可能是一个未完成的重构。

```csharp
// 修复方案
private void UpdateRendererMaterialProperties()
{
 var mpb = propertyBlock.Value;
 foreach (var renderer in renderers)
 {
 mpb.SetFloat(InternalShader.PropertyID.PerObjectShadowCasterID, perObjectShadowCasterID);
 renderer.SetPropertyBlock(mpb);
 }
}
```

> ⚠️ **注意**: 使用 `MaterialPropertyBlock` 方案需要确认 Shader 中 `_PerObjectShadowCasterID` 是通过 `UNITY_DEFINE_INSTANCED_PROP` 定义的（已确认在 `ToonCoreInput.hlsl` Line 80 中定义），因此 `MaterialPropertyBlock` 方案可行。但需要注意 `MaterialPropertyBlock` 会打断 SRP Batcher，如果这是不可接受的，则需要保留材质实例化方案但添加缓存机制避免每帧重复实例化。

---

#### 2. `UpdateCasterInfo()` 每帧全量更新，性能开销过大

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCaster.cs` → `Update()` (Line 43-46)

**问题描述**: 
`Update()` 每帧调用 `UpdateCasterInfo()`，该方法依次执行：
1. `UpdateRendererList()` — `GetComponentsInChildren` 遍历整个子层级
2. `UpdateRendererMaterialProperties()` — 遍历所有 Renderer 的所有材质（含上述泄漏问题）
3. `UpdateShadowCasterRendererList()` — 遍历所有 Renderer，检查 ShadowCaster Pass，创建 DrawCallData 列表

对于静态物体，这些信息在运行时不会变化，每帧全量重建是不必要的。

**建议修复**: 
- 引入脏标记机制，仅在层级结构变化时重新收集
- 或者将 `Update` 改为仅在需要时手动触发（如通过 `OnTransformChildrenChanged` 等回调）
- 对于 `UpdateRendererMaterialProperties`，仅在 `perObjectShadowCasterID` 变化时更新

---

#### 3. `CalculateFrustumPlanes` 在循环内每个 Caster 都重新计算

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCasterManager.cs` → `Cull()` (Line 32-52)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
foreach (var caster in perObjectCasters)
{
 // ...
 Plane[] frustumPlanes = GeometryUtility.CalculateFrustumPlanes(camera);
 // ...
}
```
`GeometryUtility.CalculateFrustumPlanes(camera)` 在 `foreach` 循环**内部**调用，每个 Caster 都会重新计算一次视锥平面并分配一个新的 `Plane[]` 数组。视锥平面对于同一个 Camera 是不变的，应该提取到循环外部。

**建议修复**: 
```csharp
public void Cull(Camera camera)
{
 rendererIndexList.Clear();
 visibleCasters.Clear();
 if (perObjectCasters.Count <= 0) return;
 
 Plane[] frustumPlanes = GeometryUtility.CalculateFrustumPlanes(camera);
 foreach (var caster in perObjectCasters)
 {
 if (!caster.TryGetWorldBounds(out Bounds bounds)) continue;
 if (!GeometryUtility.TestPlanesAABB(frustumPlanes, bounds)) continue;
 visibleCasters.Add(caster);
 }
}
```

### P1 - 中等问题

#### 4. `perObjectShadowCasterGUID` 单调递增，永不重置

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCasterManager.cs` (Line 14)

**问题描述**: 
`perObjectShadowCasterGUID` 是一个 `static int`，从 1 开始单调递增，永不重置。在长时间运行的应用中（如编辑器中反复进入/退出 Play Mode），该值会持续增长。虽然 `int` 溢出需要约 20 亿次注册，但更关键的问题是：

- 在 Shader 中通过 `float` 传递 ID（`material.SetFloat(..., perObjectShadowCasterID)`），当 ID 值超过 `2^24 = 16777216` 时，`float` 精度不足以精确表示整数，导致 Shader 中的 `CheckPerObjectCasterID` 比较失败（`abs(a - b) <= 0.01` 的容差在大数值下不够）。
- 在编辑器中频繁进入/退出 Play Mode 会加速这个问题。

**建议修复**: 
- 在 Domain Reload 或 Play Mode 切换时重置 GUID 计数器
- 或者使用 ID 回收池，复用已注销 Caster 的 ID

---

#### 5. `enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount` 缺少上限检查

**文件**: `PerLightDataCollector.cs` → `ReservePerObjectShadowCasterData()` (Line 140-151)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
public Vector4 ReservePerObjectShadowCasterData(PerObjectShadowCaster caster, int visibleCasterIndex)
{
 int enabledCasterIndex = enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount++;
 shadowMapDataPerObjectCasters[enabledCasterIndex] = ...;
 // ...
}
```
`enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount` 没有与 `MaxPerObjectShadowCasterCount` 进行上限检查。虽然调用方 `LightingPass.CollectPerLightData()` 中对 `perObjectCasterCount` 做了 `MaxPerObjectCasterCount` 的限制，但 `enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount` 和 `perObjectCasterCount` 是两个独立的计数器，且 `MaxPerObjectCasterCount`（16）和 `MaxPerObjectShadowCasterCount`（16）虽然当前值相同，但语义不同。如果未来修改其中一个值，可能导致数组越界。

**建议修复**: 
在 `ReservePerObjectShadowCasterData` 中添加上限检查：
```csharp
if (enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount >= RenderPipelineInfo.MaxPerObjectShadowCasterCount)
 return new Vector4(0f, -1f, 0f, -1f); // no shadow
```

---

#### 6. `DrawCallData.drawCallList` 每帧重新分配 `List<DrawCallData>`

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCaster.cs` → `GetShadowCasterRendererDrawCallData()` (Line 153-170)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
private List<DrawCallData> GetShadowCasterRendererDrawCallData(Renderer renderer)
{
 List<DrawCallData> drawCallList = new(); // 每次调用都 new
 // ...
 return drawCallList;
}
```
每帧 `UpdateShadowCasterRendererList()` 会为每个有效 Renderer 创建一个新的 `List<DrawCallData>`。这些列表在下一帧被丢弃，产生 GC 压力。

**建议修复**: 
使用对象池（`ListPool<DrawCallData>`）或缓存机制复用列表。

---

#### 7. `PerObjectShadowCasterManager` 混合了静态和实例成员

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCasterManager.cs`

**问题描述**: 
- `perObjectCasters`（HashSet）和 `perObjectShadowCasterGUID` 是 **static** 成员
- `visibleCasters`（List）和 `rendererIndexList` 是 **实例** 成员
- `Register/Unregister` 是 **static** 方法
- `Cull` 是 **实例** 方法

这意味着所有 Camera 共享同一个全局注册表（static），但每个 `CameraRenderer` 有自己的 `PerObjectShadowCasterManager` 实例（`CameraRenderer.cs` Line 44: `internal PerObjectShadowCasterManager PerObjectShadowCasterManager = new()`），各自维护独立的 `visibleCasters` 列表。

代码中也有 `// TODO: Singleton` 注释，说明这个设计尚未定型。当前的混合模式虽然能工作，但容易引起混淆。

**建议改进**: 
明确设计意图：
- 如果全局单例：将 `Cull` 也改为 static，或使用真正的单例模式
- 如果 per-camera：将 `perObjectCasters` 也改为实例成员

---

#### 8. `rendererIndexList` 声明但未使用

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCasterManager.cs` (Line 28)

**问题描述**: 
`private readonly List<int> rendererIndexList = new()` 在 `Cull()` 中被 Clear 但从未被添加元素或读取。这是一个死代码残留。

**建议修复**: 
移除该字段，或者如果是计划中的功能则添加 TODO 注释。

---

#### 9. `propertyBlock` 字段声明但未实际使用

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCaster.cs` (Line 19)

**问题描述**: 
`private readonly Lazy<MaterialPropertyBlock> propertyBlock = new()` 仅在 `OnDisable` 中被 Clear，但从未在 `UpdateRendererMaterialProperties` 中使用。这是一个未完成的重构残留，与问题 #1 相关。

**建议修复**: 
配合问题 #1 的修复方案使用，或者移除。

---

#### 10. `Debug.Log` 残留在生产代码中

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCasterManager.cs` (Line 21)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
Debug.Log("[ArcToonRP] Registered PerObjectShadowCaster: " + caster.perObjectShadowCasterID);
```
每次注册 Caster 都会输出日志，在正式发布时会产生不必要的日志噪音和字符串拼接开销。

**建议修复**: 
使用 `[Conditional("UNITY_EDITOR")]` 或 `#if UNITY_EDITOR` 包裹，或直接移除。

---

### P2 - 改进建议

#### 11. `DrawDebugBounds` 方法未被调用

**文件**: `PerObjectShadowCasterManager.cs` (Line 56-86)

**问题描述**: 
`DrawDebugBounds` 方法定义了完整的 AABB 线框绘制逻辑，但在整个项目中没有任何调用点。这是调试残留代码。

**建议修复**: 
添加 `[Conditional("UNITY_EDITOR")]` 标记并在 Cull 中提供可选的调试绘制入口，或移除。

---

#### 12. PerObjectShadow 的 DepthBias 硬编码

**文件**: `ShadowMapRenderer.cs` → `RenderPerObjectShadowSplitTile()` (Line 651)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
// TODO: config
commandBuffer.SetGlobalDepthBias(0f, 5f);
```
代码中已有 `TODO: config` 注释，DepthBias 值 `5f` 被硬编码。其他光源类型（Directional、Spot、Point）的 DepthBias 都来自配置或 Light 组件的设置。

**建议修复**: 
在 `ShadowSettings.PerObjectShadow` 结构中添加 `slopeScaleBias` 配置项，或从关联的 Light 组件读取。

---

#### 13. `ShadowSettings.PerObjectShadow` 配置项过于简单

**文件**: `ShadowSettings.cs` (Line 62-65)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
public struct PerObjectShadow
{
 public MapSize atlasSize;
}
```
相比其他阴影类型，PerObjectShadow 的配置项只有 `atlasSize`，缺少：
- `slopeScaleBias` / `depthBias`（当前硬编码为 5f）
- `normalBias` 缩放因子
- 最大阴影距离（当前无距离衰减）
- 是否启用的开关

**建议修复**: 
扩展 `PerObjectShadow` 结构，添加必要的配置项。

---

#### 14. PerObject 阴影缺少距离衰减

**文件**: `DirectionalLight.hlsl` → `GetDirectionalRealtimeShadow()` (Line 55-70)

**问题描述**: 
当片元匹配到 PerObject Caster 时，直接返回 PerObject 阴影结果，没有应用距离衰减（`_ShadowDistanceFade`）。而普通方向光阴影在 `GetDirectionalShadowAttenuation` 中会应用距离衰减。这意味着 PerObject 阴影在任意距离都以全强度显示，可能在远处产生不自然的硬阴影。

**建议修复**: 
在 PerObject 阴影分支中也应用距离衰减逻辑。

---

#### 15. PerObject 阴影不支持 ShadowMask 混合

**文件**: `DirectionalLight.hlsl` → `GetDirectionalRealtimeShadow()` (Line 55-70)

**问题描述**: 
PerObject 阴影分支在 `GetDirectionalRealtimeShadow` 中直接返回，绕过了 `GetDirectionalShadowAttenuation` 中的 ShadowMask 混合逻辑。如果场景使用了 Mixed Lighting + Shadowmask 模式，PerObject 阴影的物体不会正确混合烘焙阴影。

**建议修复**: 
将 PerObject 阴影的结果作为 `realtimeShadow` 返回，让外层的 `GetDirectionalShadowAttenuation` 统一处理 ShadowMask 混合。

---

#### 16. `ReservePerObjectShadowCasterData` 中注释掉的条件检查

**文件**: `PerLightDataCollector.cs` (Line 140-151)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
public Vector4 ReservePerObjectShadowCasterData(PerObjectShadowCaster caster, int visibleCasterIndex)
{
 // if (shadows != None)
 {
 // ...
 }
}
```
`// if (shadows != None)` 被注释掉，意味着所有可见的 PerObject Caster 都会无条件地分配阴影资源，即使关联的方向光没有开启阴影。

**建议修复**: 
添加对方向光阴影状态的检查，避免在无阴影光源下浪费 Atlas 空间。

---

#### 17. `BuildPerObjectRendererList` 创建了未使用的 RendererList

**文件**: `ShadowMapRenderer.cs` → `BuildPerObjectRendererList()` (Line 426-451)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
info.handle = builder.UseRendererList(renderGraph.CreateRendererList(
 new RendererListDesc(InternalShader.TagId.ShadowCaster, cullingResults, camera)
 {
 sortingCriteria = SortingCriteria.CommonOpaque,
 renderQueueRange = RenderQueueRange.all,
 })
);
```
这里创建了一个标准的 RendererList，但在 `RenderPerObjectShadowSplitTile` 中实际使用的是 `commandBuffer.DrawPerObjectShadowRenderer()`（手动 DrawRenderer），而不是 `commandBuffer.DrawRendererList(info.handle)`（已被注释掉）。这意味着每帧都在创建一个从未被消费的 RendererList，浪费了 RenderGraph 资源。

**建议修复**: 
移除 `BuildPerObjectRendererList` 中的 RendererList 创建，或者如果计划迁移到 RendererList 方案则保留并添加 TODO。

---

#### 18. PerObject 阴影未参与 `CullShadowCasters`

**文件**: `ShadowMapRenderer.cs` → `BuildRendererLists()` (Line 370-378)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
if (collector.shadowedDirectionalLightCount + collector.shadowedSpotLightCount +
 collector.shadowedPointLightCount > 0)
{
 context.CullShadowCasters(...);
}
```
`CullShadowCasters` 的条件判断中不包含 `enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount`，且 `BuildPerObjectRendererList` 中没有设置 `cullingInfoPerLight` 和 `shadowSplitDataPerLight`。这意味着 PerObject 阴影完全绕过了 Unity 的 GPU-driven shadow caster culling 系统，依赖自定义的 `DrawPerObjectShadowRenderer` 手动绘制。

这本身不是 bug（因为 PerObject 阴影使用自定义裁剪），但意味着 PerObject 阴影无法受益于 Unity 的批量裁剪优化。

---

#### 19. `MaxPerObjectCasterCount` 与 `MaxPerObjectShadowCasterCount` 命名混淆

**文件**: `RenderPipelineInfo.cs` (Line 15, 23)

**问题描述**: 
```csharp
public const int MaxPerObjectCasterCount = 16; // Line 15
public const int MaxPerObjectShadowCasterCount = 16; // Line 23
```
两个常量值相同但名称不同，分别在不同的地方使用：
- `MaxPerObjectCasterCount` → `LightingPass` 中的 Buffer 分配和 Caster 计数上限
- `MaxPerObjectShadowCasterCount` → `ShadowMapRenderer` 和 `PerLightDataCollector` 中的阴影数据数组大小

语义上它们应该是同一个值，但分成两个常量容易导致未来修改时遗漏其中一个。

**建议修复**: 
统一为一个常量名称。

---

## 模块整体评价

PerObjectShadow 模块实现了一套完整的独立物体阴影系统，包括：
- 自定义的 AABB 裁剪（Burst 优化）
- 视锥-AABB 交叉裁剪优化阴影投影范围
- 支持多方向光的 Per-Object Atlas Tile 分配
- Shader 端通过 CasterID 匹配实现 PerObject 阴影采样

核心算法（`CullUtilities.cs` 中的投影矩阵计算和视锥裁剪）质量较高，使用了 Burst 编译和 stackalloc 优化。

主要问题集中在**运行时性能**（每帧全量更新、材质泄漏、循环内重复计算）和**代码整洁度**（死代码、未完成的重构、混合的 static/instance 设计）。建议优先修复 P0 级别的性能和内存问题。

## PerObjectShadow 模块审查完成

文档已输出至 [PerObjectShadow_CodeReview_2026-04-09.md](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/ChatLogs/Bugfix/PerObjectShadow_CodeReview_2026-04-09.md)

### 发现问题总览

共发现 **19 个问题**，按优先级分布如下：

#### P0 - 严重问题（3个）
1. **`GetMaterials()` 每帧材质实例化泄漏** — `UpdateRendererMaterialProperties()` 使用 `renderer.GetMaterials()` 而非 `GetSharedMaterials()`，每帧创建新的 Material 实例导致内存泄漏。代码中已声明了 `propertyBlock` 但未使用，疑似未完成的重构。
2. **`Update()` 每帧全量重建** — `GetComponentsInChildren`、材质遍历、ShadowCaster Pass 检查等全部在每帧执行，对静态物体完全不必要。
3. **视锥平面在循环内重复计算** — `GeometryUtility.CalculateFrustumPlanes(camera)` 在 `foreach` 循环内部调用，每个 Caster 都重新计算+分配数组。

#### P1 - 中等问题（7个）
- GUID 单调递增的 float 精度溢出风险
- `enabledPerObjectShadowCasterCount` 缺少上限检查
- `DrawCallData` 列表每帧重新分配造成 GC 压力
- Manager 混合 static/instance 成员的架构问题
- `rendererIndexList`、`propertyBlock` 死代码
- `Debug.Log` 残留在生产代码中

#### P2 - 改进建议（9个）
- DepthBias 硬编码（已有 TODO 注释）
- PerObjectShadow 配置项过于简单
- 缺少距离衰减和 ShadowMask 混合支持
- 创建了未使用的 RendererList
- 未参与 Unity 的 CullShadowCasters 系统
- 两个含义相同的常量命名混淆等

### 模块整体评价

核心算法质量较高（Burst 优化的裁剪计算、视锥-AABB 交叉裁剪），主要问题集中在**运行时性能**（每帧全量更新、材质泄漏）和**代码整洁度**（死代码、未完成重构）。建议优先修复 P0 级别问题。"},"timestamp":1775668521,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

\"# ArcToon RP — 定向光 PCSS 阴影实现问题分析\\n\\n> 分析日期：2026-03-26 \\n> 涉及文件： \\n> - `ShaderLibrary/Shadow.hlsl` \\n> - `ShaderLibrary/PoissonDisk.hlsl` \\n> - `ShaderLibrary/Light/DirectionalLight.hlsl` \\n> - `ShaderLibrary/Light/SpotLight.hlsl` \\n> - `ShaderLibrary/Light/PointLight.hlsl` \\n> - `Runtime/Passes/Lighting/ShadowMapRenderer.cs` \\n\\n---\\n\\n## 背景\\n\\nArcToon RP 的阴影系统支持 PCF、Poisson Disk、PCSS 三种软阴影模式，适用于定向光、聚光灯和点光源。本文档聚焦于 **PCSS（Percentage-Closer Soft Shadows）** 在定向光下的实现问题，同时涉及部分影响全光源类型的通用问题。\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 问题 1（严重度：高）：定向光 Penumbra Estimation 公式错误\\n\\n### 现状\\n\\n`FilterShadowPCSS()` 中的 Penumbra 计算（Shadow.hlsl 约第 299~305 行）：\\n\\n```hlsl\\nfloat zReceiver = positionSTS.z;\\n#if defined(UNITY_REVERSED_Z)\\nfloat penumbraWidth = _PcssLightSize * (avgBlockerDepth - zReceiver) / max(avgBlockerDepth, 0.001);\\n#else\\nfloat penumbraWidth = _PcssLightSize * (zReceiver - avgBlockerDepth) / max(avgBlockerDepth, 0.001);\\n#endif\\n```\\n\\n该公式来自经典 PCSS 论文（Fernando 2005）：\\n\\n$$\\nw_{penumbra} = w_{light} \\\\times \\\\frac{d_{receiver} - d_{blocker}}{d_{blocker}}\\n$$\\n\\n### 问题\\n\\n这个公式的物理推导基于**透视投影的相似三角形**——`d_blocker` 代表遮挡物到光源的距离，除以它是为了建立光源大小在遮挡物平面上的投影关系。\\n\\n但**定向光使用的是正交投影**：\\n\\n- 深度值是**线性的**，表示片元在光方向上相对于 near/far plane 的归一化线性位置\\n- 光线是平行的，不存在\\\"到光源的距离\\\"这个概念\\n- 除以 `avgBlockerDepth` 在正交投影下**没有物理意义**\\n\\n### 深度空间详细分析\\n\\n**定向光的变换链路：**\\n\\n```\\n世界空间 → View 矩阵 → 正交 Projection → ConvertToAtlasMatrix → positionSTS\\n```\\n\\n- Unity 为定向光计算正交投影矩阵，`z_clip = A·z_view + B`（线性变换）\\n- `ConvertToAtlasMatrix` 对 Z 行做 reversed-Z 翻转 + [0,1] 映射，仍保持线性\\n- 正交投影 `w = 1`，HLSL 端直接取 `.xyz`，**不需要透视除法**\\n\\n因此 `zReceiver` 和 `avgBlockerDepth` 都是 [0,1] 范围的正交线性深度，它们的差值 `|zReceiver - avgBlockerDepth|` **直接正比于**遮挡物与接收面在光方向上的世界空间距离。\\n\\n**对比 Spot/Point 光：**\\n\\n```hlsl\\n// SpotLight.hlsl / PointLight.hlsl\\nfloat shadow = FilterSpotShadow(positionSTS.xyz / positionSTS.w, ...); // 透视除法\\n```\\n\\nSpot/Point 光经过透视除法，z 是非线性 NDC 深度。经典 PCSS 公式在此方向上是正确的（虽然用非线性深度是近似，但为业界惯例）。\\n\\n### 症状\\n\\n- 遮挡物靠近 near plane 时（`avgBlockerDepth` 接近 0），除法导致 penumbra **爆炸式放大**\\n- 远处 penumbra 被不合理地压缩\\n- 半影宽度随深度绝对值非线性波动，表现不一致\\n\\n### 修复建议\\n\\n定向光应使用简化公式，直接用深度差：\\n\\n```hlsl\\n// 定向光专用\\nfloat penumbraWidth = _PcssLightSize * abs(zReceiver - avgBlockerDepth);\\n```\\n\\n平行光下半影宽度只取决于遮挡物到接收面的距离和光源角直径，与\\\"遮挡物在投影空间中的绝对深度位置\\\"无关。\\n\\n可以为定向光单独定义一个 `FilterShadowPCSS_Directional`，或通过宏/分支区分正交和透视投影的 penumbra 计算。\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 问题 2（严重度：中）：Poisson Disk 旋转种子输入值错误\\n\\n### 现状\\n\\n`FilterShadowPoisson` / `FilterShadowPCSS` 以及对应的 Clamped 版本中，Poisson Disk 的初始化：\\n\\n```hlsl\\nInitPoissonDisk(positionSTS.xy * atlasSize.x);\\n```\\n\\n### `_DirectionalShadowAtlasSize` 的打包格式\\n\\nC# 端赋值（ShadowMapRenderer.cs）：\\n\\n```csharp\\ndirectionalAtlasSizes.x = directionalAtlasSizes.y = 1f / atlasSize; // texel size (1/4096)\\ndirectionalAtlasSizes.z = directionalAtlasSizes.w = atlasSize; // atlas size (4096)\\n```\\n\\n即：`.x = .y = 1/atlasSize`（texel size），`.z = .w = atlasSize`。\\n\\n### 问题\\n\\n`InitPoissonDisk` 的目的是用屏幕位置生成 per-pixel 随机旋转角度（通过 `InterleavedGradientNoise`），以消除 Poisson Disk 采样的规律性 banding。\\n\\n但 `positionSTS.xy` 在 [0,1] 的 Atlas UV 空间，乘以 `atlasSize.x`（= 1/atlasSize ≈ 0.000244）会得到一个极小的值（约 0~0.000244），导致 `InterleavedGradientNoise` 的输入极度集中，**大面积像素使用几乎相同的旋转角度**。\\n\\n### 症状\\n\\n- 软阴影出现明显的**规律性条纹（banding）**\\n- Poisson Disk 的旋转去噪效果几乎无效\\n\\n### 修复建议\\n\\n应该乘以 `.z`（= atlasSize）来获得像素坐标范围：\\n\\n```hlsl\\nInitPoissonDisk(positionSTS.xy * atlasSize.z); // → 得到 [0, 4096] 范围的像素坐标\\n```\\n\\n> **影响范围**：此问题同时影响 Poisson Disk 和 PCSS 两种模式，同时影响所有光源类型（定向光、聚光灯、点光源）。\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 问题 3（严重度：中）：定向光 CSM 缺少 Tile Clamping\\n\\n### 现状\\n\\nSpot 和 Point 光使用的是 `FilterShadowPCSSClamped` / `FilterShadowPoissonClamped`，会把采样坐标 clamp 到 tile 边界内：\\n\\n```hlsl\\n// Clamped 版本\\nfloat2 sampleCoord = clamp(positionSTS.xy + offset, tileMin, tileMax);\\n```\\n\\n但定向光用的是**无 clamp** 的 `FilterShadowPCSS` / `FilterShadowPoisson`。\\n\\n### 问题\\n\\n定向光的 CSM（Cascaded Shadow Maps）同样是多个 cascade 分块排列在同一张 Atlas 上。当 Poisson Disk 采样半径较大时，**边缘像素的偏移采样可能越过 tile 边界，采到相邻 cascade 的深度数据**。\\n\\n对于小半径 PCF（3×3 / 5×5 / 7×7），越界影响不明显。但 PCSS 的 `searchRadius` 和 `dynamicRadius` 可以非常大，问题会凸显。\\n\\n### 症状\\n\\n- Cascade 边界处出现**阴影接缝**\\n- **光照泄漏**——采到其他 cascade 的深度导致错误的遮挡判断\\n\\n### 修复建议\\n\\n为定向光同样实现 Clamped 版本的滤波函数，传入每个 cascade tile 的边界范围。参考 Spot/Point 光的 `FilterShadowPCSSClamped` 实现。\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 问题 4（严重度：低）：全遮挡提前返回导致软硬阴影过渡不连续\\n\\n### 现状\\n\\n```hlsl\\nif (numBlockers >= POISSON_SAMPLE_COUNT - 0.5) return 0.0;\\n```\\n\\n当所有 16 个 Poisson 采样点都找到了 blocker，直接返回完全阴影（0.0），跳过 PCF 滤波步骤。\\n\\n### 问题\\n\\n这是一个合理的性能优化，但跳过 PCF 意味着在全遮挡区域和部分遮挡区域之间存在**硬边过渡**——从 `return 0.0`（硬阴影）突然切换到 PCF 计算的软阴影值。\\n\\n### 症状\\n\\n- 在极端情况下（比如大面积遮挡区域的边缘），可能观察到一圈硬边\\n- 实际场景中通常不太明显，因为全遮挡区域的 PCF 结果本身也接近 0\\n\\n### 修复建议\\n\\n优先级低。如果需要修复，可以移除这个提前返回，或改为在 numBlockers 接近最大值时平滑过渡。\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 各光源类型深度空间对比\\n\\n| 光源类型 | 投影方式 | positionSTS.z | 透视除法 | 深度线性 | 当前 penumbra 公式 |\\n|---------|---------|---------------|---------|---------|------------------|\\n| **定向光** | 正交投影 | 正交线性深度 | 无（w=1） | ✅ 线性 | 除以 blockerDepth → ❌ 不正确 |\\n| **聚光灯** | 透视投影 | NDC 非线性深度 | ✅ 有 | ❌ 非线性 | 除以 blockerDepth → ⚠️ 近似，业界惯例可接受 |\\n| **点光源** | 透视投影 | NDC 非线性深度 | ✅ 有 | ❌ 非线性 | 同聚光灯 |\\n\\n---\\n\\n## 修复优先级\\n\\n| 优先级 | 问题 | 影响面 | 复杂度 |\\n|-------|------|-------|-------|\\n| **P0** | Penumbra 公式对定向光不正确 | 定向光 PCSS | 低（改一行公式 + 分支） |\\n| **P1** | Poisson Disk 旋转种子输入错误 | 全光源 Poisson/PCSS | 低（改 `.x` 为 `.z`） |\\n| **P1** | 定向光 CSM 缺少 Tile Clamp | 定向光 Poisson/PCSS | 中（需新增 Clamped 函数 + 传递 tile 边界数据） |\\n| **P2** | 全遮挡提前返回硬边 | 全光源 PCSS | 低（可选修复） |\\n\\n... {"messageId":"019d68b9e7d774aea74ce2cd94df1e9a","rawEvent":{"message_id":"019d68b9e7d774aea74ce2cd94df1e9a","conversation_id":"019d620d485e7f76beddd748ead616dd","content":"现在我对整个代码结构有了清晰的理解。让我分析一下更优雅的修复方案。

## 问题分析

**问题1的核心**：`FilterShadowPCSS` 和 `FilterShadowPCSSClamped` 中的 penumbra 公式使用了经典透视投影的 PCSS 公式 `lightSize * (dReceiver - dBlocker) / dBlocker`，但定向光使用正交投影，深度是线性的，不应该除以 `avgBlockerDepth`。

## 设计思路

文档建议的方案是"为定向光单独写一个函数或通过宏/分支区分"，但这会导致代码重复。我提出一个更优雅的方案：

**通过一个 `bool isOrthographic` 参数来统一 penumbra 计算**。将 penumbra estimation 提取为一个内联辅助函数，根据投影类型选择不同的公式：

- **正交投影**（定向光）：`penumbraWidth = lightSize * abs(zReceiver - avgBlockerDepth)`
- **透视投影**（Spot/Point）：`penumbraWidth = lightSize * (dReceiver - dBlocker) / dBlocker`（经典公式）

这样只需在 `FilterShadowPCSS` / `FilterShadowPCSSClamped` 函数签名中增加一个 `bool` 参数，调用方传入即可，不需要复制整个函数。

让我实现这个方案："},"timestamp":1775578543,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

## 修复记录

### 问题 1 修复（2026-04-08）：Penumbra Estimation 正交/透视统一

**修复方案**：提取 `EstimatePenumbraWidth()` 辅助函数，通过 `bool isOrthographic` 参数统一正交投影和透视投影的 penumbra 计算，避免代码重复。

**修改文件**：`ShaderLibrary/Shadow.hlsl`

**核心改动**：

1. 新增 `EstimatePenumbraWidth(lightSize, zReceiver, avgBlockerDepth, isOrthographic)` 函数：
 - 正交投影：`penumbraWidth = lightSize * depthDiff`（线性深度，直接用深度差）
 - 透视投影：`penumbraWidth = lightSize * depthDiff / blockerDepth`（经典 PCSS 公式）
2. `FilterShadowPCSS` / `FilterShadowPCSSClamped` 签名增加 `bool isOrthographic` 参数
3. 调用方传入投影类型：
 - `FilterDirectionalShadow` / `FilterPerObjectShadow` → `isOrthographic = true`
 - `FilterSpotShadow` / `FilterPointShadow` → `isOrthographic = false`

**设计优势**：
- 无代码重复：不需要为定向光单独复制一套 PCSS 函数
- 编译器常量折叠：`bool` 字面量传入后，三元运算符会被编译器优化为单一分支，零额外开销
- 扩展性好：未来如有其他正交投影光源，只需传入 `true` 即可

**状态**：✅ 已修复

> 注：问题 2（Poisson Disk 旋转种子）已在此前修复（`.x` → `.z`）。问题 3、4 暂未修复。","apply_mode":"apply_only"}},"timestamp":1775578601,"type":"TOOL_CALL_ARGS"}

---

## 修复方案总结

### 问题回顾

文档中的 **问题1（P0）**：定向光 PCSS 的 Penumbra Estimation 公式使用了经典透视投影公式 `lightSize * (dReceiver - dBlocker) / dBlocker`，但定向光使用**正交投影**，深度是线性的，除以 `avgBlockerDepth` 没有物理意义。这会导致：
- 遮挡物靠近 near plane 时 penumbra 爆炸式放大
- 远处 penumbra 被不合理压缩
- 半影宽度随深度非线性波动

### 改进方案（相比文档建议）

文档建议"为定向光单独定义一个 `FilterShadowPCSS_Directional`，或通过宏/分支区分"。这种方式会导致大量代码重复（整个 PCSS 函数需要复制一份）。

我采用了更优雅的方案——**提取统一的 penumbra 估算辅助函数**：

**新增 `EstimatePenumbraWidth()` 函数**（[Shadow.hlsl](/Users/archerdu/UnityProject/ArcToonRP/Packages/com.arctoon.render-pipeline/ShaderLibrary/Shadow.hlsl) 第 248~263 行）：

```hlsl
float EstimatePenumbraWidth(float lightSize, float zReceiver, float avgBlockerDepth, bool isOrthographic)
{
 float depthDiff = ...; // reversed-Z aware
 float penumbraWidth = isOrthographic
 ? lightSize * depthDiff // orthographic: linear depth
 : lightSize * depthDiff / max(avgBlockerDepth, 0.001); // perspective: classic PCSS
 return max(penumbraWidth, 0.0);
}
```

### 设计优势

1. **零代码重复**：`FilterShadowPCSS` / `FilterShadowPCSSClamped` 只需增加一个 `bool isOrthographic` 参数，不需要复制整个函数
2. **零运行时开销**：调用方传入的是编译期常量 `true`/`false`，编译器会通过常量折叠将三元运算符优化为单一分支 [[memory:4tfux7po]]
3. **语义清晰**：`EstimatePenumbraWidth` 函数名和注释明确表达了正交/透视两种投影的物理差异
4. **扩展性好**：未来如有其他正交投影光源，只需传入 `true` 即可

### 修改的调用关系

| 入口函数 | `isOrthographic` | 原因 |
|---------|:-:|------|
| `FilterDirectionalShadow` | `true` | 定向光 = 正交投影 |
| `FilterPerObjectShadow` | `true` | Per-object shadow 也是定向光的正交投影 |
| `FilterSpotShadow` | `false` | 聚光灯 = 透视投影 |
| `FilterPointShadow` | `false` | 点光源 = 透视投影 |"},"timestamp":1775578619,"type":"TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT"}

\\n**严重程度**: 潜伏 Bug（默认配置不触发）\\n\\n**问题**：`RenderPointShadowSplitTile` 中构造 `PointShadowBufferData` 时，第四个参数错误地使用了 `spotAtlasSizes.x` 而非 `pointAtlasSizes.x`。当 Spot 和 Point 的 atlas
